description: This file defines the 'MinimumVersionSelector' class, which implements the IVersionSelector interface. Its purpose is to select the minimum compatible version from a list of available versions based on compatibility checks performed by an 'ICompatibilityDirector' instance.

classes.name: MinimumVersionSelector
classes.description: A class that selects the minimum compatible version from a list of available versions.

methods.name: GetSuitableVersion
methods.description: Returns the minimum version from available versions that is compatible with the requested version, as determined by the 'ICompatibilityDirector'.
